tool.name: pyshp
tool.scope: Build/diagnostic only; no installation or app dependency change

scope: Offline source partition augmentation, fixed anchors and paid land transfers; retains v4 even where Census is missing. Source/geometry bytes do not establish nationwide size or real driving accuracy. Original visits are losslessly packed; supplemental visits keep bends at the existing 1e-5 degree quantization. No hosted/reference calls or production activation.
